name: Islands and Protected Areas of the Gulf of California
description: Scattered across the Gulf of California, between Mexico's Baja California peninsula and the mainland, are 244 rugged islands, islets and coastal areas. Their high cliffs and sandy beaches stand out against desert glare and turquoise water. The sea is exceptionally rich in life: 891 fish species, 90 of them found nowhere else, and about a third of the world's cetacean species.
